test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. No R is a G.

II. All G’s are H.

**Conclusions:**

I. No H is a R.

II. No G is a R.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
Statement:

I. No R is a G.

II. All G’s are H.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e35f4f31be567ad78c4572f2f3d3749dff332b32f4206f6fca3d2113d459cd30.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) No H is a R - False (Because No definite relation given between H and R, so it can be possible only).

(ii) No G is a R - True (No R is G, so No G is also R).

Here, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
